verdict.rationale: Datadog's own docs include a Bits AI page and a Datadog Watchdog page, which point to first-party AI assistance and automated insights inside the product. However, the pack holds only page titles, with no content describing what insights or suggestions are generated from user data. A community note praising outlier analysis adds only thin support. missing for 10: documented detail on how Bits AI produces insights and suggestions from user telemetry, a description of Watchdog's insight output, and hands-on or independent corroboration of the AI insights in use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Outlier analysis cited as a key advantage of Datadog and New Relic over open-source alternatives.
